familySummary: Joy chaise sofas combine a relaxed chaise layout with a clean, left-oriented profile in white for contemporary living spaces.
familyDescription: The Joy family presents chaise sofas with a streamlined look suited to modern seating areas. Each piece is defined by its left orientation and white finish, creating a calm, coordinated presence in the room. This chaise sofa measures 246 × 155 × 75 cm and is specified in Fabric, Metal, Plywood, Polyester. Its layout pairs a chaiselongue with a two-seater section and armrest, offering a practical shape for lounging and everyday use.
